body: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.
summaryZh: SWE-Critix 是一套用于评估编码智能体执行轨迹的后训练通用验证器流水线。针对长周期软件工程任务中缺乏预定义成功标准的问题，该系统通过监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）训练 30B 参数模型，使其能够对智能体的执行轨迹进行分类并生成自然语言解释。实验结果显示，该验证器在 CodeForge-Preview 数据集上的准确率从基准模型的 57% 提升至 78%，为自动化软件工程任务的可靠性评估提供了重要工具。

glossary.explanationZh: 编码智能体，能够自主执行软件工程任务的AI系统。
执行轨迹，智能体在完成任务过程中与环境交互的完整记录。
预言机评估器，指能够提供绝对正确答案或成功标准的评估机制。
后训练，指在预训练模型基础上进行的进一步微调或强化学习过程。
